title: build(release): npm version syncs plugin.json + version-consistency test guard
why: Root-cause fix for the 0.8.0-0.8.2 manifest drift (CHANGELOG bumped, manifests stuck at 0.7.0): npm version (patch/minor/major) now auto-rewrites and stages plugin.json via scripts/sync-version.mjs; test/version.test.js turns node --test red whenever package.json / plugin.json / CHANGELOG top diverge.

title: chore(release): bump version 0.7.0 -> 0.8.2
why: Sync package.json + .claude-plugin/plugin.json with CHANGELOG; 0.8.0/0.8.1/0.8.2 shipped without a manifest bump.

title: fix(runner): disallow Write/Edit tools in claude rewrite call — LLM was attempting Write instead of stdout, causing frontmatter quality gate failures (analyst/theme/flow pages all failed with 'frontmatter missing title/summary')
